notes: User-approved universal headword; route determination remains distinct from vehicle control.

english_meaning: To buy; to acquire goods access or services into one's possession through payment
derivation: An inward or into one's sphere + Vanesh formal trade
notes: User-approved inward commercial action; distinct from generic trade.

english_meaning: To sell; to transfer goods access or services out of one's possession in return for payment
derivation: Thal from or outward + Vanesh formal trade
notes: User-approved outward commercial action; distinct from generic trade.

english_meaning: To import; to bring goods or services through a jurisdictional border into the jurisdiction through trade
derivation: Lorzhir jurisdictional border + An inward + Shan passage or transfer
notes: User-approved trade-bound border-crossing verb; not generic entry.

english_meaning: To export; to send goods or services through a jurisdictional border out of the jurisdiction through trade
derivation: Lorzhir jurisdictional border + Thal from or outward + Shan passage or transfer
notes: User-approved trade-bound border-crossing verb; not generic departure.

english_meaning: Ownership; an established state or recognized right of direct possession control use exclusion or transfer
derivation: Ian direct possession + -ath established or enduring state
notes: User-approved property concept; never applies ownership to people kin sacred relations or belonging.

english_meaning: Weapon; an object or device designed or deliberately used to injure disable threaten or destroy
derivation: New one-syllable primitive: weapon or purpose-built harmful implement
notes: User-approved universal primitive; initial n and g both contribute audibly and only the explicitly approved derivatives are authorized.

english_meaning: Sword; a long handheld bladed weapon used for cutting or thrusting
derivation: Ngar weapon + Pel sharpness piercing quality
notes: User-approved universal headword; does not replace Peleth as knife or blade.

english_meaning: Spear; a long shafted pointed weapon used for thrusting or throwing
derivation: Ngar weapon + Zhir narrow linear form
notes: User-approved universal headword; does not redefine standalone Zhir as a shaft or weapon.

english_meaning: Bow; a tension weapon that stores force through bending and releases it to launch an arrow
derivation: Rav pull or tension + Jor sudden energetic release
notes: User-approved lexicalization of the bow mechanism; not a general word for springs slings or launchers.

english_meaning: Arrow; a slender pointed projectile launched from a bow
notes: User-approved universal headword for the bow-launched projectile.

english_meaning: Shield; a handheld worn generated or projected defensive barrier that intercepts or deflects attack
derivation: Arth defense + Kal force or strength
notes: User-approved external attack-intercepting barrier; distinct from armor shelter walls and Arthlor shield formations.

english_meaning: Gun or firearm; a controlled mechanical weapon that launches a material projectile through explosive pressure or comparable discharge
derivation: Ngar weapon + Jor burst or discharge
notes: User-approved material-projectile firearm category; directed-energy weapons remain Ngarzhel.

english_meaning: Energy weapon; a weapon that directs electrical magical kinetic radiant or comparable non-material energy
derivation: Ngar weapon + Zhel spark energy or charge
notes: User-approved directed-energy weapon category; distinct from Ngarjor firearms.

english_meaning: Ammunition or firing charge; a consumable projectile cartridge charge or stored firing unit loaded or supplied to a weapon
derivation: Ngar weapon + Vek carried charge or substance
notes: User-approved functional ammunition category; ordinary batteries remain Zhelkav unless serving as consumable weapon charges.

english_meaning: Militia; a locally organized body of community members or citizens trained and available for collective defense commonly alongside ordinary civilian work
derivation: Wel community or shared action + Arth defense
notes: User-approved universal headword; distinguished from a formally commanded army.

english_meaning: Army or armed force; a formally organized body trained equipped and commanded for sustained armed operations
notes: User-approved universal headword dependent on the approved Ngar primitive.

english_meaning: Patrol; an organized watch journey repeatedly made through an area to observe warn deter danger or maintain security; also the group making that journey
derivation: Kes attention or noticing + Var purposeful movement
notes: User-approved activity and group polysemy; security purpose distinguishes it from ordinary travel.

english_meaning: Siege; a sustained operation that encloses isolates or denies passage and supplies to a fortified place in order to compel surrender
derivation: Xar covering or enclosure + Kaleth fortress or stronghold
notes: User-approved universal headword; names the imposed operation rather than the defending position.

english_meaning: Trap; a concealed or prepared device placement or situation intended to capture restrain injure or disable
derivation: Veth hidden or unseen + Bel binding or restraint
notes: User-approved literal hidden binding or restraint; does not broaden Bel into a generic compound element.

english_meaning: Target; a person place object or point deliberately selected as the focus of observation pursuit action or attack
derivation: Lor directed focus or sightline + Pel precise point
notes: User-approved neutral target concept; selection does not imply hostility.

english_meaning: To aim; to align one's attention body tool weapon or projected action toward an intended target
notes: User-approved target-alignment verb; distinct from broader guidance by Lorin.

english_meaning: To shoot or fire; to launch a projectile or directed discharge from a weapon
derivation: Ngar weapon + Jor burst or release + -aen verb
notes: User-approved weapon-bound discharge verb; distinct from the broader assault Jorkal.

english_meaning: To block or parry; to intercept stop or turn aside an incoming strike projectile or directed attack
derivation: Arth defense + Kar strike or applied force + -aen verb
notes: User-approved event-specific defensive verb; general protection remains Arth.

english_meaning: To retreat or withdraw from danger or combat while preserving purposeful movement cohesion or the possibility of continued action
derivation: Vethvar behind or toward the rear + -aen verb
notes: User-approved purposeful withdrawal; does not inherently mean uncontrolled flight.

english_meaning: To surrender; to cease resistance and submit oneself or one's force to an opposing authority or power
derivation: Ka cessation or without-state + Arth defense or resistance + -aen verb
notes: User-approved formal yielding verb; ordinary refusal remains Ka or Verka.

english_meaning: Poison or toxin; a substance that disrupts bodily function or causes illness injury or death through ingestion contact inhalation or injection
derivation: Mav bodily illness + Mor physical substance
notes: User-approved harmful-substance category; ordinary medicine is not poison merely because a harmful dose is possible.

english_meaning: War; sustained organized armed conflict between political communities states peoples or major factions
derivation: Rath hostile opposition or foe + Nor continuing time or event duration
notes: User-approved organized armed-conflict meaning; medial n distinguishes it from Rathor past or history.

english_meaning: Battle; a bounded armed encounter or major clash usually occurring within a larger war or campaign
derivation: Rath hostile opposition + Jor forceful surge or clash
notes: User-approved bounded encounter; distinct from one attack and from sustained war.
